_doc: Image registry for automation/assets.mjs (Sqwod Verified product photos, EN+DE parity). LINK/IMAGE INTEGRITY: only wire an ASIN that is (1) the NEW product (never a Renewed/Refurbished ASIN) and (2) sold by Amazon or the brand (not a 3rd-party marketplace reseller) — verify 'Sold by' + condition on the live listing before adding. Amazon's buy-box rotates, so re-verify periodically. IMAGE SELECTION: use the product's PRIMARY (1st/main) listing image at max resolution (the ..._AC_SL1500_.jpg variant) — it's the most representative/popular shot; the review page renders it on a white card. TWO ways to fill each product: (1) MANUAL now — paste image URLs grabbed via Amazon SiteStripe; or (2) AUTO later — set `asin` and, with PA-API keys, the script pulls images. Manual `images` always win. DTC products with no clean Amazon listing (Whoop, Eight Sleep, Gymshark, Ten Thousand, Alo, Seed, Ritual, Momentous): leave empty → branded diamond placeholder. Editorial fields/scores are never touched.
